protocol.slate: Line followed by three separately spoken digits; tolerate recognised numeric equivalents.
protocol.retake: Retake. Then repeat the same Line cue and the entire content after a one-second pause.
protocol.instructions: All bracketed material is silent direction, never target audio.
protocol.selection: Keep every take. Suggest the last complete take; flag ambiguity and mismatches for listening.
protocol.phonics: Use slate and waveform boundaries, not ordinary word recognition. Review all 26 sounds.
protocol.splitting: Do not split at internal sentence pauses; do not infer filenames from segment order alone.
protocol.missing: Report missing or unexpected IDs; never shift later assignments to fill a gap.
protocol.source_audio: Preserve the original and record sample offsets for every proposed export.
protocol.privacy: Run recognition and segmentation locally; do not upload the recording.

Short i, as in in. Not eye.
The j sound at the start of jam. Make the sound only.

Ul, ending in l. Not the letter name and not luh.
The m sound at the start of moon. Make the sound only.
The n sound at the start of nest. Make the sound only.
Short o, as in off or on. Not oh.
The p sound at the start of pot. Make the sound only.
The qu sound at the start of queen. Make the sound only.
Sustained r, as in rurrrr. Not the letter name.
The s sound at the start of sun. Make the sound only.
The t sound at the start of top. Make the sound only.
Short u, as in up. Uh, not you.
The v sound at the start of van. Make the sound only.
The w sound at the start of wet. Make the sound only.
Kus: one sound sequence, not the names of letters.
The y sound at the start of yes. Make the sound only.
Voiced zzzuh. Not suh and not the letter name.
